mmd_policy: exact-end-only; no stale carry, future score, fallback or imputation
normalization: pooled benign fit checkpoint ECDF; right-continuous (#fit<=x + 1)/(m+1)
score_orientation: higher-is-more-anomalous; sequential PRADA export=-W; CUSUM export=positive statistic; MMD export=raw MMD
calibration: benign calibration stream maxima; rank ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)); strict >; no finite threshold if rank>n
calibration_missingness: reject incomplete calibration streams; do not silently drop observations
evaluation_missingness: abstain when required component unavailable; report incomplete coverage and exclude from conditional complete-stream FPR denominator explicitly
scientific_status: software prototype; synthetic numeric tests only; no performance estimation or detector selection
